meta.description: A repeating profile from 0 on a crest to 1 in a trough, count times from value 0 to 1. Into the margin of leaf_surface it cuts teeth, into a thickness it makes rings.

value.description: Where to read the wave, alpha when nothing is connected.

count.description: How many crests from value 0 to 1.

shape.description: Sine undulates, tooth is a symmetric point (dentate), saw leans toward higher values (serrate), round has round crests and sharp troughs (crenate).
